content:
**Travel Agent** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Enables fast traveling while Encumbered at higher cost.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You can Fast Travel while over encumbered at an increased cost. | 003BE30C | 

Before update 60, the perk reduced fast travel cost by 30%. This effect was removed from the perk, instead player fast travel cost was reduced by 25%.
